rule_description: Verify transaction amount is not zero
action: Set alert code to 1004, alert message to Invalid amount, and go back
evidence: if RCV-AMOUNT = 0 move 1004 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Invalid amount" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 9001, alert message to Account file error, and go back
evidence: if WS-ACC-STATUS not = "00" move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 9002, alert message to Journal file error, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-JRN-STATUS not = "00" move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

condition: WS-ACC-STATUS evaluates to status 23 on account read
action: Set alert code to 1001, alert message to Account not found, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: when "23" move 1001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account not found" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback

condition: WS-ACC-STATUS is neither 00 nor 23 on account read
action: Set alert code to 9001, alert message to Account file error, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: when other move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback

action: Set alert code to 1002 and alert message to Account blocked
evidence: when ACC-BLOCKED move 1002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account blocked" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Set alert code to 1003 and alert message to Account closed
evidence: when ACC-CLOSED move 1003 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account closed" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Set alert code to 9001 and alert message to Invalid account status
evidence: when not ACC-ACTIVE move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Invalid account status" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Set alert code to 1007, alert message to Insufficient funds, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if ACC-BALANCE < RCV-AMOUNT move 1007 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Insufficient funds" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 1005, alert message to Balance overflow, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-NEW-BALANCE > 999999999999999 move 1005 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Balance overflow" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 9001, alert message to Account update error, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-ACC-STATUS not = "00" move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account update error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

rule_description: Check journal write status and rollback on failure
action: Set alert code to 9002, alert message to Journal write error, perform ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-JRN-STATUS not = "00" move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal write error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if
